$comment: The second go/no-go on the Beads adapter, decided GO by the maintainer. The bar is not 'an adapter exists' -- it is that the scenario 33 said could neither pass nor fail now runs through a real tracker's own export, and that binding it changes no disposition (INV-002).

criteria.$comment: Reads .beads/issues.jsonl, not the store: ADR-033 says a repo-local provider answers about the checked-out revision, and an embedded Dolt database is neither tracked nor revision-scoped.
Generated by `bd export --all`, not hand-authored. A fixture written to satisfy the adapter proves the adapter reads the fixture.
adapters/beads is registered, so C1-C10 apply to it: honest advertisement, typed errors, claims nothing when its source is absent.

The load-bearing one. Both execution providers must reach the SAME disposition from structurally different sources; divergence would mean an execution provider contributing authority, which INV-002 forbids and a single-provider suite cannot see.

criteria.target: f=$(mktemp); printf '%s\n' '{"_type":"issue","id":"x","status":"snoozed","external_ref":"A-1"}' > $f; REPO_GOVERNOR_BEADS=$f python3 adapters/beads query execution get_tasks id=A-1 | grep -q MALFORMED_SOURCE
criteria.$comment: The status map is closed. A forwarded unknown status yields a task that is neither active nor complete with nothing saying so -- an empty answer where an error belongs.

criteria.target: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/.beads; git init -q $d; python3 -c "import sys;from pathlib import Path;sys.path.insert(0,'engine');import onboard as O;c=O.detect(Path('$d')).get('execution') or [];assert c and c[0]['adapter'] is None, c"; cp conformance/fixtures/beads-issues.jsonl $d/.beads/issues.jsonl; python3 -c "import sys;from pathlib import Path;sys.path.insert(0,'engine');import onboard as O;c=O.detect(Path('$d')).get('execution') or [];assert c and c[0]['adapter'] == 'adapters/beads', c"
criteria.$comment: Detection may name an adapter only if that adapter can read the evidence that triggered the detection. A bare .beads/ store gets no adapter; the export gets adapters/beads. Both halves asserted, because only naming it when present is half the rule.
The join key is documented where an integrator reads, not only in the adapter docstring.
